verdict.rationale: Teller offers webhooks that fire on enrollment/data changes, enabling event-driven background processing without polling, which is the closest analog to autonomous automation for this financial-data API. However there's no evidence of an AI-agent framework, scheduling/orchestration engine, or any AI-native automation tooling — webhooks are a generic API feature, not an agentic automation capability. Missing for 10: AI agent orchestration support, scheduled/recurring automation tooling, explicit AI-native automation framework or examples.
